hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Sort the array initially so that the minimum absolute difference in any chosen subset always occurs between adjacent elements.

hints.title: State Formulation
hints.text: Define a recursion tracking current element index, remaining elements to select, last selected index, and current minimum difference.

hints.title: Transitions and Modulo
hints.text: Branch on either skipping or choosing the current element. Update the running minimum gap and take results modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: State memoization over index, remaining count, previous element, and minimum gap.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all combinations of length k takes exponential O(C(n, k)) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort first to constrain adjacent differences and apply memoized recursion.
